newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RUGBY UNION-CHINA WINS IRFB RECOGNITION.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-CHINA WINS IRFB RECOGNITION.

text.p: China was officially recognised as a rugby playing nation on Tuesday when it became the 76th member of the sport's world governing body.

International Rugby Football Board (IRFB) chairman Vernon Pugh presented Li Gaochao, secretary general of the Beijing-based Chinese Rugby Football Association (CRFA), with a certificate of membership during a 10-a-side tournament in Hong Kong.
The IRFB said that rugby was becoming popular in dozens of colleges in China and the number of players was expected to multiply.
